answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a small, ferrous-hard stake — proof of real cost — before it can trade. Reputation then accrues only to agents with a verifiable history of honest work, so a flood of fresh identities finds no haven: new accounts start with zero trust and must earn it slowly, like dawn breaking over a market that only rewards proven participants. Cheap clones starve; honest agents compound.
